prompts.title: Recent form · wins, draws and losses
prompts.prompt: Vertical 9:16 composition, charcoal background #101412, warm white #edf0e6 text, lime #c5ed74 for NK Celje, slate #8ca6bf for Omonia Nicosia. Reserve the lower quarter as a permanent yellow subtitle band (#f2e14c) — all chart geometry and headlines stay above that line. EDITORIAL VARIANT (kinetic typography, rhythmic emphasis): 0–1.2s the Spanish headline "FORMA RECIENTE" slams in letter by letter in condensed uppercase, tracking tightening on the beat, warm white, occupying the upper third. 1.2–3.5s the two Spanish team names slide from opposite edges, "NK Celje" from left in lime, "Omonia Nicosia" from right in slate, then their three result words — "victorias", "empates", "derrotas" — stack beneath each name, each word punching in on a rhythmic accent while its count ticks up from zero in tabular figures. 3.5–6.5s the main comparison: the winning-count words scale up one notch and hold while a thin lime rule and a thin slate rule draw toward the centre and stop, no numeric axes, no sample claims, no match events. 6.5–8.5s emphasis on "Omonia Nicosia · victorias" ({{away.wins}}) with a subtle chromatic jitter and a slow camera push of roughly one tenth of frame width. 8.5–10s exit: everything collapses into a single horizontal lime line that wipes upward. Transition to the statistical variant is a vertical split wipe along the centre axis. STATISTICAL VARIANT: grouped count bars sharing one zero baseline and one common linear scale whose maximum is the largest of the six values rounded up to the next whole count; three category groups on the x axis labelled in Spanish — "VICTORIAS", "EMPATES", "DERROTAS" — with two bars per group, lime for NK Celje, slate for Omonia Nicosia, all bars starting from the same baseline at the lower edge of the upper three quarters. Bar values come from {{home.wins}}, {{home.draws}}, {{home.losses}}, {{away.wins}}, {{away.draws}}, {{away.losses}}; y axis labelled "partidos" with tick labels rendered from the shared scale. A source and sample annotation sits pinned above the subtitle band: "Fuente: Bzzoiro · Muestra: {{home.n}} partidos · Muestra: {{away.n}} partidos", making clear both samples are the same length. 0–1.5s axes and Spanish labels fade in; 1.5–5s bars grow from the baseline with a 0.15s stagger, lime group then slate group; 5–8s the main comparison highlights the "VICTORIAS" pair with a lime-to-slate bracket and a brief highlight bar; 8–10s values rest statically, then the chart exits with a fast horizontal wipe and a subtle camera drift upward.

prompts.title: Goals for and against on the pitch
prompts.prompt: Vertical 9:16, charcoal #101412 stage, warm white #edf0e6 type, lime #c5ed74 for NK Celje, slate #8ca6bf for Omonia Nicosia, yellow subtitle band occupying the lower quarter and never overlapped. EDITORIAL VARIANT (illustrative football pitch and ball path): 0–1.5s a stylised pitch outline in thin warm-white strokes draws itself from the centre circle outward, slightly perspective-tilted, filling the upper three quarters. 1.5–4.5s two curved ball paths arc across the pitch — a lime path looping from the left touchline into the goal, a slate path looping from the right — each ball leaving a motion trail that fades to zero opacity. 4.5–7s the Spanish labels "GOLES A FAVOR" and "GOLES RECEBIDOS" appear beside each team name, with counts animating in: NK Celje {{home.gf}} a favor, {{home.ga}} recibidos; Omonia Nicosia {{away.gf}} a favor, {{away.ga}} recibidos. No axes, no sample claims, no invented match events. 7–9s emphasis on the net bulge nearest the slate side as the camera pushes in gently by one eighth of frame height; 9–10s the pitch strokes retract to a single lime centre-circle ring that wipes off. Transition in from the previous scene is a soft cross-dissolve with a lime line sweep; transition out is a scale-to-zero fade. STATISTICAL VARIANT: paired horizontal bars on the same charcoal field, one shared linear scale with a common zero baseline at the left edge of the content column, maximum set to the larger of the four goal values. Two labelled rows in Spanish — "NK Celje" and "Omonia Nicosia" — each holding a pair: solid bar for "Goles a favor" ({{home.gf}}, {{away.gf}}) and hollow outlined bar for "Goles recibidos" ({{home.ga}}, {{away.ga}}), same colour family per team, unit label "goles" on the axis. 0–1.5s Spanish row labels and axis fade in; 1.5–5s bars extend from the baseline with a 0.2s stagger, favor first, received second; 5–8s the main comparison draws a thin warm-white bracket between the two "a favor" values and another between the two "recibidos" values; 8–10s a lime highlight ring circles the longest bar before everything settles. Source and sample annotation is rendered above the subtitle band as "Fuente: Bzzoiro · Muestra: 5 partidos recientes" resolved from the attached sample of each fact, and the camera holds static so the values stay legible.

prompts.title: Clean sheets · defensive shutouts
prompts.prompt: Vertical 9:16, charcoal #101412, warm white #edf0e6, lime #c5ed74 for NK Celje, slate #8ca6bf for Omonia Nicosia, permanent yellow subtitle band across the lower quarter. EDITORIAL VARIANT (defensive energy, stylised shield): 0–1.5s a geometric shield outline assembles from four lime strokes and four slate strokes meeting at a shared vertical seam in the upper third, with a faint radial pulse suggesting defensive pressure. 1.5–4.5s each half of the shield breathes independently; the Spanish heading "ARCOS EN CERO" types on in condensed uppercase above the seam. 4.5–7s team names appear in Spanish — "NK Celje" on the lime half, "Omonia Nicosia" on the slate half — with their shutout counts rising from zero with a slight overshoot: {{home.clean}} and {{away.clean}}. No statistical axes, no sample claims, no invented match events in this variant. 7–9s the main comparison is a duel of pulse speed: the slate half pulses once more than the lime half, camera drifting laterally by one twentieth of frame width. 9–10s exit: the shield collapses to a single warm-white horizontal bar that wipes left. Transition in is a lime diagonal wipe; transition out is a scale-down fade. STATISTICAL VARIANT: two count bars, shared zero baseline, shared linear scale whose maximum is the larger of the two shutout counts rounded up, drawn in the content column above the subtitle band. Horizontal bars: lime bar labelled "NK Celje" resolving {{home.clean}}, slate bar labelled "Omonia Nicosia" resolving {{away.clean}}; axis unit "partidos" in Spanish, and crucially the counts are never converted into rates. Sample sizes stay visibly attached to the counts: a Spanish annotation line above the bars reads "Muestra: {{home.n}} partidos" under the lime bar and "Muestra: {{away.n}} partidos" under the slate bar, plus the source line "Fuente: fixtures · Bzzoiro". 0–1.5s baseline, ticks and Spanish labels fade in; 1.5–4.5s bars grow from the baseline with a 0.25s stagger, lime first; 4.5–7.5s the main comparison draws a warm-white measuring bracket spanning both bar ends and a soft lime highlight fills the longer bar; 7.5–10s values hold with a slow, nearly imperceptible camera push, then the scene exits with a vertical wipe upward into the next block.

prompts.title: Grounded tension · attack versus shutouts
